final_answer:
Meta and Amazon are both reporting on a comparable fiscal-year (calendar year) basis, so the figures are directly comparable.

Meta Platforms revenue grew from $134,902M (FY2023) to $164,501M (FY2024), a ~21.9% increase [DOC: Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017]. Amazon's net sales grew from $574,785M (FY2023) to $637,959M (FY2024), a ~11.0% increase [DOC: Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004].

Meta's revenue growth rate (≈21.9%) outpaced Amazon's (≈11.0%) by roughly 11 percentage points.

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 11 percentage points (Meta ~21.9% vs. Amazon ~11.0% revenue growth from FY2023 to FY2024).
